name: Light (Wizard Elemental Arcane School)
body:
Light represents good, charm, knowledge, purity, and clarity of mind. Wizards who specialize in this school are often confused with clerics of good, but are not necessarily of a good alignment.

A wizard who specializes in the light element gains a number of school powers and one bonus spell slot of each level that the wizard can cast, from 1st on up. This bonus spell slot must be used to prepare a spell from the light elemental school’s spell list. Unlike a normal arcane school, the light elemental school requires the wizard to select the darkness elemental school (soon to appear in a future issue of this Library) as his opposition school. A wizard must expend two spell slots to prepare a spell from the darkness elemental school as normal. He does not need to select a second opposition school.

Light Magic

At 1st level, add the following spells to your wizard spell list at the listed spell level: 2nd–blinding ray, light lance, 3rd–searing light, 4th-blade of light, burst with light, 6th-blazing rainbow, 7th-morning sun, sunbeam

Light Supremacy (Su)

You gain a +2 enhancement bonus on Perception checks. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 wizard levels you have. In addition, you can cast light at will as a spell-like ability that uses your caster level. At 5th level, you gain darkvision in a 60 ft. radius. At 10th level, you gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against dazzling and blinding effects.

At 20th level, you become immune to the dazzled condition, blindness, and illusion spells and effects that rely on sight.

Rainbow Halo (Su)

You can surround yourself with a multicolored aura that shifts continuously in hue, granting you concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier.

Power of the Sun (Su)

At 8th level, all spells you cast with the light descriptor are automatically affected as if by the Solar Spell C&C metamagic feat, but with no increase in spell level.

Light Elementalist Wizard Spells

0th–dancing lights, flare, light; 1st–color spray, dancing lantern, dazzling blade, flare burst, hypnotism, magic missile, snapdragon fireworks, unwelcome halo; 2nd–blinding ray, burst of radiance, continual flame, detect thoughts, enchantment sight, fear the sun, flickering lights, fox’s cunning, hypnotic pattern, light lance, light prison, pyrotechnics, revealing light; 3rd–arcane sight, campfire wall, dark-light, daylight, mass dazzling blade, motes of dusk and dawn, pierce disguise, searing light, silverlight, spotlight, stolen light, sunstalker, wall of split illumination; 4th-blade of light, brightest light, burst with light, greater hypnotism, inhibiting pattern, moonstruck, mydriatic spontaneity, rainbow pattern, unbearable brightness, wandering star motes; 5th-scintillating wall, telepathic bond, thoughtsense, wall of light; 6th-blazing rainbow, chains of light, mass fox’s cunning, telepathy, true seeing, wall of silver; 7th–greater arcane sight, mass mydriatic spontaneity, morning sun, prismatic spray, sunbeam; 8th–prismatic wall, scintillating pattern, sunburst; 9th–prismatic sphere.
